title: Doesn't look nice 😕
text:
Doesn't look nice 😕. Now while this cling was pretty easy to put up, and it seems to be sticking pretty well I was expecting the outcome to be a lot better..
It just doesn't look very pretty with all the blotches in-between the lines..

BEAUTIFUL LOOK – Immediately transform any space with the luxurious frosted glass look this window film offers. The intricate engravings and clean-cut design offer an upscale and elegant appeal to any room it’s placed in.
USES AND DETAILS - window film is rolled up and rolled into various sizes; Finnez film can be used for glass windows, sliding doors, glass furniture, etc.
